mobbin:6583d026-d49c-48e6-8f2c-b0ce5c034.summary: From an in-app Membership screen (barcode/ID visible) the user opens a multi-section Online Shopping Service Survey, fills required ratings and multi-selects, reviews answers, submits, and sees a thank-you, with no QR and no login prompt on the form itself.
steps: Review: Submit / Back to Entry Form
steal: A Required * badge on the first section makes mandatory rubric items obvious on phone (screen 2).
Numbered sections (1. Overall Satisfaction, 2. Reason…, 3. Navigation…, 4. Overall) instead of a progress bar for long phone forms (screens 2-4).
A Review screen with Submit plus 'Back to Entry Form' so answers are confirmed before commit (screen 5).
A minimal thank-you confirmation with no extra main-button noise after submit (screen 6).
avoid: Starting the phone form from a logged-in Membership hub with barcode/ID (screen 1): Essentials' post-session QR path should open the checklist without requiring an app account home.
mobbin:6583d026-d49c-48e6-8f2c-b0ce5c034.fit: Scenario manager: phone-side multi-section checklist fill, review and confirmation matches the learner/faculty form after a session; entry via Membership (not QR) and no QR in-flow means it is checklist UX, not the TV-QR distribution path.
